purpose: Fail-closed rules for admitting a brand-new Shine application into the canonical reviewed ecosystem for the first time.
preconditions: Exactly one pending_review candidate identifies the application release being reviewed.
The application id is absent from the canonical reviewed ecosystem ledger.
No current certification receipt exists for the application.
No accepted review candidate or accepted review decision already exists for the application.
The candidate repository, profile path, release/profile identities, policies and evidence are valid under the canonical review-candidate contract.
The decision timestamp is not earlier than candidate observation.
onboardingState: A new reviewed ecosystem ledger entry is created from the exact candidate identity.
A certification receipt is created for that exact reviewed identity and the current immutable canonical-registry snapshot.
Exactly one accepted review decision is appended for the candidate.
After onboarding, the app becomes promotion-managed and must satisfy review-promotion-v1 for later re-certifications.
atomicity: Candidate acceptance, initial reviewed-ledger entry, certification receipt and accepted review decision are one onboarding unit.
A partial first certification is invalid even when each changed file is individually well-formed.
The onboarding helper is dry-run first, verifies the resulting Defence state after writing, and restores every touched file when verification fails.
nonClaims: A pending onboarding candidate does not grant a Defence badge.
First certification does not certify later application commits.
The onboarding helper does not replace app-specific review evidence or tests.
Certification remains subject to current revocation and release-claim rules.
